newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss debt prices were lower in slow late trade, with a holiday in the U.S. sapping European markets of momentum.
"We began weaker at the start of the session. But we were able to hold up, with 112.80, an important chart point, offering support," one Swiss trader said.

He said activity was quiet partly because of the U.S. Labor Day holiday. Investors are also nervous ahead of the release of new U.S. data this week. The U.S. National Association of Purchasing Managment releases its August index on Tuesday. On Friday U.S. employment data are due.
Sept comi medium-term bond down 10 at 109.40.
Sept Euro Swiss francs steady at 97.80.
